settings.title: What is the difference between CBD oil and CBD cream?
settings.text: The primary difference between CBD oil and CBD cream lies in their application and absorption. CBD oil is typically taken orally or sublingually (under the tongue) and is absorbed into the bloodstream, however poorly due to the fact that humans are made mostly of water. It's often used for overall wellness benefits like stress relief, pain management, and improved sleep but must be taken in high quantity due to their poor absorpotion rates. CBD cream, on the other hand, is applied topically to the skin and is intended for localized relief. It's commonly used for targeted pain relief, inflammation, and skin conditions, without systemic effects.

settings.title: What is CBD topical cream?
settings.text: CBD topical cream is a product infused with CBD that is applied directly to the skin. It’s designed for localized relief from pain, inflammation, and various skin conditions. The cream interacts with cannabinoid receptors in the skin, offering targeted relief without entering the bloodstream. This makes it ideal for treating specific areas of discomfort or skin issues. CBD creams are often used to alleviate muscle soreness, joint pain, and skin conditions like eczema or psoriasis. They are non-intoxicating and typically do not have psychoactive effects.

settings.title: How long does CBD cream stay in your system?
settings.text: The length of time CBD cream stays in your system can depend on various factors, including the dosage, frequency of use, and individual metabolism. While CBD generally has a short half-life, meaning it doesn't stay in the body for an extended period, trace amounts may still be detectable in some individuals. However, it's important to note that CBD is non-intoxicating and does not have the same psychoactive effects as THC. NextEvo Naturals' CBD creams are made with high-quality, THC-free CBD, ensuring they comply with legal requirements and are safe for regular use.

settings.title: How long does CBD cream last?
settings.text: The duration of the effects of CBD cream can vary depending on several factors, such as the quality of the cream, the concentration of CBD, and individual factors like metabolism and body chemistry. Generally, the effects of CBD cream can last anywhere from a few hours to several hours. It's important to remember that everyone's experience may differ, and it may be necessary to reapply the cream if needed. NextEvo Naturals is committed to providing high-quality CBD creams that are designed to deliver long-lasting relief.

settings.title: Does CBD cream interact with medications?
settings.text: CBD cream, when used topically, is generally considered safe and unlikely to interact with medications. However, it's always crucial to consult with a healthcare professional before using CBD cream or any other CBD product, especially if you are taking medications. They can provide personalized advice based on your specific circumstances and help identify any potential interactions or contraindications. Transparency and open communication with your healthcare provider are essential for ensuring your safety and optimizing the effectiveness of your treatment.

settings.title: Can CBD cream make you feel weird?
settings.text: CBD cream typically does not cause any significant psychoactive effects or make the user feel weird. Unlike THC, CBD is not known for its intoxicating properties. CBD creams are generally used topically and are primarily absorbed into the skin without entering the bloodstream in significant amounts. However, individual reactions may vary, and some people may experience mild side effects such as skin irritation or allergic reactions. It's always a good idea to patch test a small area before applying CBD cream to a larger area of the body.

settings.title: How does CBD cream work?
settings.text: CBD cream is applied topically to the skin and works by interacting with the endocannabinoid receptors located in the skin. When applied, the CBD in the cream is absorbed through the skin and can potentially provide relief to the specific area of application, along with any other active ingredients such as menthol, Vitamen E, and shea butter. CBD cream may have soothing and moisturizing properties, making it useful for promoting healthy skin. It's important to choose a high-quality CBD cream, like those offered by NextEvo Naturals, to ensure the best results. As with any skincare product, it's advisable to perform a patch test and consult with a dermatologist if you have any concerns.

settings.title: Can I use CBD cream alongside other CBD?
settings.text: Yes, CBD cream can be used alongside other CBD products as the CBD in creams does not enter the bloodstream like with oral ingestion methods. Additionally, using multiple CBD products simultaneously can provide a more comprehensive experience and target different areas of concern. However, it's advisable to start with lower dosages and monitor your body's response. It's also recommended to consult with a healthcare professional or a knowledgeable CBD expert for guidance on proper usage, potential interactions, and to ensure that the combination of CBD products is safe and appropriate for your specific needs.

settings.title: Can CBD cream help with arthritis?
settings.text: CBD cream may help alleviate arthritis symptoms. CBD has shown potential anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties, which can be beneficial for reducing pain associated with inflammation and arthritis. However, individual results may vary, and it is recommended to consult with a healthcare professional before using CBD cream for arthritis. They can provide personalized advice and guidance based on your specific condition and medical history.

settings.title: Can I use CBD recovery cream alongside other CBD products?
settings.text: CBD recovery cream can generally be used alongside other CBD products. Combining different CBD formulations, such as recovery cream and other CBD products like gummies or capsules, may provide an enhanced effect for muscle recovery and relaxation. However, it's important to consider the CBD dosage and consult with a healthcare professional or CBD expert to ensure that the combination is suitable for your specific needs and does not exceed safe usage limits.

settings.title: What are the cons of CBD cream?
settings.text: The cons of CBD cream primarily relate to its localized effect, as it only targets specific areas rather than providing systemic benefits. Some users may not find it as effective for overall wellness needs. Additionally, the exact dosage can be difficult to measure with creams, and the absorption rate can vary depending on skin type and the specific formulation of the product. There's also the possibility of skin irritation or allergic reactions, especially in individuals with sensitive skin or allergies to other ingredients in the cream. When trying a new skin cream, do a test patch first before applying on a larger area of the skin.

settings.title: What are the side effects of CBD creams?
settings.text: Side effects of CBD creams can include skin irritation, redness, or rash, particularly in individuals with sensitive skin. Some users might experience allergic reactions to other ingredients in the cream, not necessarily due to CBD itself. There's also the possibility of the cream interfering with other topical medications or products. Since CBD creams are absorbed through the skin, systemic side effects are rare, but sensitivity to CBD or other components in the cream can occur, leading to localized discomfort or irritation. It's best to test a new cream on a patch of skin to ensure it doesn't cause irritation before applying it on a larger area of skin.

settings.title: What does CBD cream do to your body?
settings.text: CBD cream, when applied to the skin, interacts with local cannabinoid receptors. It's primarily used for localized relief from pain, inflammation, and skin conditions. CBD cream can offer targeted relief from muscle soreness, joint pain, and various skin issues like eczema or psoriasis. Its anti-inflammatory properties can reduce swelling and redness. The cream doesn't enter the bloodstream, so it doesn't have systemic effects, making it a good option for those who want localized relief without the psychoactive effects of THC.

settings.title: Which is better CBD or hemp creams?
settings.text: Deciding between CBD and hemp creams depends on your needs. CBD creams are primarily used for therapeutic purposes like pain relief, reducing inflammation, or soothing skin conditions due to CBD’s anti-inflammatory properties. Hemp creams, while they may contain trace amounts of CBD, are generally used for moisturizing and nourishing the skin, as hemp seed oil is rich in omega fatty acids. If you’re looking for targeted pain relief or to address specific skin issues, CBD isolate cream is likely the better choice. For general skincare, cream with hemp seed oil is sufficient.

settings.title: Will CBD cream cause positive drug test?
settings.text: CBD cream typically contains only trace amounts of THC, if any, and is unlikely to cause a positive drug test. Topical products like creams are applied to the skin and generally do not enter the bloodstream in significant amounts. Therefore, they are unlikely to show up on a drug test, which usually screens for THC. However, it's important to choose creams from reputable brands that provide third-party lab test results to ensure the product's THC content is within legal limits. NextEvo Naturals' CBD Body Recovery Cream contains zero THC.
